div.span:
U can also do redirection using nginx: -
1. HTTP → HTTPS redirect (common once you add SSL)
2. Redirect www ↔ non-www (same idea, different match)
3. Redirect to a different domain/path (true HTTP redirect, browser-visible)

Your header won't show even if the backend were up — add_header in nginx only applies to
responses with these status codes by default: 200, 201, 204, 206, 301, 302, 303, 304, 307, 308. It's
skipped on error responses (4xx/5xx) unless you add the always parameter:

server/location/if only. map/geo → http block, for
defining reusable variables everywhere.)
